additional_info.subject: Semih
additional_info.body:
Remote support for Finland Plugit: after Update the Router was nomore accessible via WebUI, just via linux commandline. Logs were sending routerloginfailed (checked last bootup with .service) also in journalctl we saw router login failed
did a firstboot on router + reboot,  charger configured the router new then did some cleanup changes stil not connecting to OCPP checked both router and ocpp config via SCB
router was set to wired (must be mobile) set mobile and add APN again
OCPP URL was ws://10.71.209.50:4900 changed to
ws://ocpp-16-json.gcp.plugit.fi OCPP went online
Issue solved
